info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - MPLS, VPN & Segment Routing
info.description:
MPLS, L2VPN, L3VPN, VXLAN, segment routing, performance measurement.

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - MPLS, VPN & Segment Routing.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - MPLS, VPN & Segment Routing.yang)

get.description:
Retrieve mpls configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace mpls configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update mpls configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove mpls configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
